name: vague-redesign-exploration
prompt: I'm not happy with our transaction history UI. Explore some different directions for it.
expectations: Inspect project before asking configuration questions

name: explicit-spikes
prompt: Create 4 UI/UX spikes for our device onboarding flow.

name: ideas-only
prompt: Give me 7 different high-level UX directions for our analytics page, ideas only.

name: redesign-options
prompt: I want competing redesign options for the settings screen before we commit.

name: continue-exploration
prompt: Continue the dashboard UI exploration and push the dense option further.
expectations: Branch or update the referenced direction

name: productionize-selected
prompt: Make the UI direction we picked production-ready.

name: routine-button-edit
prompt: Make this button 8px taller and use the primary token.
expectations: Do not invoke design-space exploration for routine implementation

name: bug-fix
prompt: Fix the modal that doesn't close after saving.
expectations: Treat as implementation bug, not design exploration

name: exact-existing-design
prompt: Implement this approved Figma screen exactly in our existing components.

name: accessibility-audit
prompt: Audit the checkout page for accessibility issues and fix them.
expectations: Do not generate competing directions unless asked

name: single-component-request
prompt: Add a searchable combobox to the customer form.
expectations: Routine component implementation is not exploration

name: explicit-alternatives-for-component
prompt: Before we implement the date picker, explore 3 meaningfully different interaction approaches for choosing a reporting range.
expectations: Do not confuse interaction divergence with visual skins
